Rae: Heads-up: after GA we have a mixed bag of bugs + small enhancement asks. Need a 30m fast-pass to pin the next minor. Can we do a quick rubric and lock owners?
Noah: Yes. Proposal: rank by (impact * customers) then effort. Impact: P0/P1/P2. Effort: S/M/L. Keep hotpatches for P0 only.
Kim: Agree. Also, if an enterprise SLA is at risk, escalate to hotpatch even if P1.
Jules: Dev caveat: some P2 changes are deceptively high effort (model retrain or infra roll). Mark those as "investigate" rather than include automatically.
status-bot: Alert: 18 release-tagged events in last 12h. Top events: session-drop(62), auth-timeout(29), ui-glitch(11).
Rae: Good context. Can someone pull unique users affected and customer list? Noah?
Noah: On it. Running a quick Sentry export and ticket join. Command:

```bash
sentry-cli search "release:GA-2026 AND tag:release" --fields=count,users --limit=40
```

Noah: Will sync back in 90m with a heat-ranked list.
Kim: I'll triage session-drop and auth-timeout. Jules can take ui-glitch and small UX asks.
Jules: Quick note: reserve the term "hotpatch" for high-risk fixes only. Prefer canary + rollback for infra config flips.
Rae: Decision rules to record here:
- P0 OR >2 enterprise customers affected -> hotpatch (cut, test, deploy)
- P1 w/ >3% user impact -> urgent-but-scheduled (next minor with canary)
- P2 or single-customer -> backlog or small enhancement sprint
Rae: Action items:
- Noah: user/customer mapping + heatlist (90m)
- Kim: triage session-drop + auth-timeout + add T-shirt sizes (EOD)
- Jules: collect UX asks, estimate small enhancements (EOD)
- Rae: run 30m decision sync in #product-ops in 2h
status-bot: Canary status: healthy. 0 new regressions on canary in last hour.
Noah: Update: session-drop affects ~1.8% active users, 3 enterprise orgs showing repeats. Streaming infra trace scheduled.
Kim: Early triage: auth-timeout likely retry/backoff misconfig in proxy. Small fix if true (S). Session-drop needs deeper trace (M).
Jules: UX asks mostly QOL. One high-visibility enterprise wants embedding order tweak (customer-commit) — mark separately for comms.
Rae: With Noah's numbers, session-drop becomes P1 with multi-customer impact. We will not hotpatch unless RCA shows trivial fix. Move to urgent scheduled for next minor with a canary-first rollout.
Rae: Final note: keep a mitigation doc for any deferred P1 (workaround steps, temporary toggle). We'll update customers tagged as impacted by EOD.
Kim: Adding labels in tracker: hotpatch-candidate, urgent-nextminor, backlog-low, customer-commit.
Jules: I'll draft the comms for the enterprise asking for embedding tweak and link to the follow-up ticket.
Rae: Thanks all. I'll post the decision summary after the sync and close this thread.
